title: Signed audio delivery is not public
description:
## Behavior
```gherkin
Feature: Audio access control
  Scenario: Done job returns short-lived signed URL
    Given a done job for a site key
    When GET /jobs/{hash} is called with that site key
    Then the response includes a short-lived signed CloudFront or S3 URL
    And the raw S3 object is not publicly readable
```

## Implementation brief
1. S3 bucket block public access; CloudFront with signed URLs.
2. Router signs URL scoped to site key request.
3. Acceptance: bucket policy denies public GetObject.
right_now_summary: Signed audio delivery is being secured with short-lived URLs while direct S3 access stays private.
